svg.title: Glacier container architecture
svg.desc: Docker Compose topology for Glacier. The browser opens http://localhost:8080; the host publishes only port 8080, mapped to port 80 of the nginx container. All eight containers share one bridge network, glacier_default: nginx, three backend replicas (port 3000), redis (6379), mariadb-primary and mariadb-replica (3306) and minio (9000), none of which is published to the host. Request path: 1) browser to nginx through localhost:8080, 2) nginx proxies /api and /gateway round-robin to backend:3000, 3) the backend writes to mariadb-primary and runs SQL reads on mariadb-replica, which follows the primary through binlog replication. The backend also uses redis for cache and pub/sub and minio for file uploads, and nginx serves /files from minio. Four named volumes hold the data: glacier_redis at /data, glacier_mariadb-primary and glacier_mariadb-replica at /var/lib/mysql, and glacier_minio at /data.
svg.text: Only nginx publishes a port; the rest stay internal
